name: Spain

train.sum: Atocha and Chamartin are the main stations, with AVE high-speed trains to Barcelona, Seville and Valencia. Cercanias commuter trains reach the suburbs.
train.sched: Cercanias runs from about 05:00 or 06:00 until about midnight. High-speed departures through the day.
tickets: Cercanias in zones 1 and 2: about 1.70 EUR, more for outer zones
Madrid to Barcelona high speed: fares vary a lot, cheapest when booked early
Ouigo and Iryo: low-cost high-speed operators
train.tip: For long distance, compare Renfe, Ouigo and Iryo prices.
buy: Renfe: renfe.com, the Renfe app, or ticket offices and machines in stations
Ouigo: its website and app. Iryo: iryo.eu, the Iryo app or Iryo desks in stations
Cercanias: station machines and ticket offices, or the new Renfe Cercanias app. Many stations also take a contactless bank card at the gates
Not possible on board. High-speed and long-distance trains need a ticket with a seat before you board
No ticket on board: high-speed and long-distance pay double the fare, Media Distancia the fare plus 5 to 10 EUR, Cercanias the fare plus double the top fare of the zone

tram.sum: Madrid Metro has 12 lines plus the short Ramal, and is one of the largest in Europe. Metro Ligero light rail serves the north and west.
tram.sched: Metro about 06:00 to 01:30. Line 6 closes at 23:00 from Sunday to Thursday during works.
tickets: Metro single ticket in zone A: about 1.50 EUR, a flat fare since October 2026
10-trip ticket: about 7.30 EUR, also valid on EMT buses
Tarjeta Multi: a reloadable card, 2.50 EUR, free with the Tourist Travel Pass
Tourist Travel Pass: 1 to 7 days, from about 10.30 EUR for zone A
tram.tip: Add a 3 EUR airport supplement when entering or leaving the metro at the airport. The zone A Tourist Travel Pass includes it.
buy: Ticket machines in every metro station, by cash or card
Tap a contactless bank card or phone at the gates, about 1.50 EUR a trip
Tarjeta Multi card and 10-trip tickets: metro machines, estancos (tobacconists) and other authorised shops
Not possible on board. Buy before you pass the gates or board Metro Ligero

bus.sum: EMT buses cover the city, and interurban buses use the big bus stations such as Plaza de Castilla and Moncloa.
bus.sched: Day buses about 06:00 to 23:30 on weekdays, 07:00 to 23:00 at weekends. Night buses (Buhos) leave from Cibeles.
tickets: EMT single ticket: about 1.50 EUR, pay on board by card or cash
10-trip ticket on the Tarjeta Multi works on buses
bus.tip: The Airport Express bus runs 24 hours. It leaves from Atocha by day and from Cibeles at night.
buy: On board from the driver: about 1.50 EUR, by bank card or cash (change given for up to 5 EUR)
Tap a contactless bank card or phone on the reader when you board
EMT ticket kiosks at Atocha and the airport sell single tickets
10-trip tickets on the Tarjeta Multi: metro machines and estancos, not on board
Interurban green buses: pay the driver by card or cash, about 1.50 EUR in town or 3 EUR between towns

airport.sum: Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas (MAD) is the main airport, on the north-east edge of the city.
airport.sched: Metro line 8 takes about 12 minutes from T1-T2-T3 to Nuevos Ministerios, about 20 minutes from T4. Cercanias C1 also serves terminal T4.
tickets: Metro: about 1.50 EUR plus 3 EUR airport supplement
Taxi to the centre inside the M-30: fixed 33 EUR
airport.tip: The fixed taxi fare covers any trip between the airport and the area inside the M-30 ring road, day or night.
buy: Metro line 8: buy a ticket plus the 3 EUR airport supplement at station machines or ticket offices. Contactless bank cards also work at the gates
Cercanias C1 at T4: Renfe machines in the station. Free with many AVE tickets
Express Airport bus: about 5 EUR, pay the driver by bank card or use the kiosks at T1, T2, T4 and Atocha. The Tourist Travel Pass is not valid
City buses 200 and 101: about 1.50 EUR from the driver, card or cash
Free shuttle bus between the terminals, no ticket needed

metro.note: Madrid Metro has 12 lines plus the short Ramal branch line. Line 1 is light blue and line 6 is the grey circular line.
metro.mapLabel: Find the metro map on the Metro de Madrid site
lines: Lines 1 to 12 and the Ramal (Opera to Principe Pio)
Sol, Callao and Gran Via serve the centre
Atocha connects to Renfe trains and AVE
Nuevos Ministerios links to line 8 for the airport

tips: Avoid peak hours, roughly 08:00 to 09:30 and 18:00 to 20:00.
You can tap a contactless bank card or phone at metro gates instead of buying a ticket.
The Tourist Travel Pass pays off if you ride several times a day.
The Metro fine without a valid ticket is 80 EUR, cut to 40 EUR if you pay on the spot or within 15 days.
